name: Mire Choirwarden

Traits.name: Swarm Touch
Traits.text: A creature that touches the choirwarden or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
Traits.expresses: a plague-bearing corruption that spreads from its touch
Traits.expressedQuote: has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn

Traits.name: Swarm Veil
Traits.text: The choirwarden doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Traits.name: Drone Slip
Traits.text: When a creature the choirwarden can see ends its turn within 5 feet of it, the choirwarden can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The choirwarden makes three Fly-Rake attacks.

Actions.name: Fly-Rake
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage. If the choirwarden flew at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Slashing damage and, if it is Large or smaller, has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Swarm Descent (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: The choirwarden flies up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it passes within 5 feet during this movement is targeted once by the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 17. *Failure:* 66 (12d10) Poison damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Aerial Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The choirwarden takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: A lesser herald of a pestilence god, it was sent from its celestial choir bearing a swarm that will not let it return until every village it touches has been marked.

generation.userConcept: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms

monsterDescription: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms
